checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Three separate square images, not a collage
Bottle matches silhouette, proportions, lid and matte finish
must.why: Same bottle, lid and loop. Bench shot is slightly stockier and has a ribbed base. Close-up shoulder looks slightly pinched.

must.item: White-background shows entire bottle, table removed
must.why: Whole bottle on white, table gone, soft shadow.

must.item: Lifestyle places bottle convincingly on gym bench
must.why: Bottle stands on a padded bench with a gym in the background. It looks plausible.

must.item: Close-up shows lid and matte surface without new features
must.why: Lid, loop and matte body are clear. No new features. The loop has a slightly altered opening.
No text or logos in any image.

faults.what: Bench shot adds a ribbed or vented base that the original lacks, and the body looks slightly wider.
Close-up has a soft focus and a slightly pinched shoulder. The loop opening is slightly altered.
The white image's bottle is slightly slimmer and glossier than the original.

summary: Three clean square images with a faithful bottle and no text. Minor details drift, such as the ribbed base in the bench shot and the soft close-up.
